headings.description: Used for all page titles, card headers, and stat numbers. Provides a modern, tech-forward, and structured feel. DO NOT use Inter or generic sans for headings.

body.description: Used for all data tables, inputs, labels, and general body copy. Provides excellent legibility for dense ERP data and numbers.

overlines_labels.description: For small tags, column headers, and status badges.

colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity, Truth) adapted for Professional ERP
colors.primary: bg-indigo-600 (#4F46E5) - Trustworthy, professional, and clear. Used for CTAs and primary actions.

functional.success: emerald-500 (#10B981) - For positive stock moves, successful payments.
functional.warning: amber-500 (#F59E0B) - For low inventory, pending tasks.
functional.error: red-500 (#EF4444) - For unpaid invoices, critical errors.

rules: The Tinted Grey Rule: Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Always use Slate or Zinc.
Focus States: Must have higher contrast, e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500.
Never use full-screen gradients. Keep surfaces flat and functional.

visual_enhancers.cards: Cardless or strictly rectangular with 1px border-slate-200. No massive soft shadows. Subtle shadow-sm on hover.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky headers or modal overlays: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200/50.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the grid skeleton where possible. border-collapse for data-heavy sections.

layouts.grid_system: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6.
layouts.navigation: Collapsible Dark Left-Sidebar. 15+ items MUST be grouped using Accordions (e.g., Operations, Finance, System). Modified F-Pattern layout.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. p-6 or p-8 inside cards to prevent text collision.
layouts.progressive_disclosure: Use Tabs heavily (Accounting has 8 tabs, Inventory has 8 tabs). Hide secondary data inside slide-overs or drill-downs.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary CTAs or Sharp/Slightly rounded (rounded-md) for data actions. Explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-indigo-700 hover:text-white).
components.inputs_forms: Use Shadcn components. Explicit focus rings.
components.tables: Shadcn Table. Left-align text, right-align currency (INR) and numbers. Sticky headers for long lists.
components.tabs: Clean underline style or pill-shaped. Override Shadcn default h-9 with h-auto to prevent cutoff.
components.toasts: Use Sonner for all notifications (already installed).
components.charts: Use Recharts (already installed). Avoid custom complex charts; stick to Line (trends) and Bar (comparisons).

motion.interactions: Hover states (slight lift -translate-y-0.5), click/press states, focus states.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties, NOT 'transition: all'. Example: transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform.
motion.charts_loading: Use simple skeleton loaders for data blocks before Recharts renders.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA/WCAG AA standards against backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
accessibility.focus: Clear focus indicators for keyboard navigation.

media.icons: Use lucide-react (default) for standard actions. For high density, run `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react` and use Phosphor icons.
media.images: Not heavily required for ERP, but if needed for user avatars or empty states, use high-quality abstract tech/business illustrations.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`. This disrupts reading flow.
Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic: no generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Implement the 'Dark sidebar with light content area' pattern common in premium ERP apps.
Format all currency values in INR format explicitly.
Ensure all 15+ sidebar items are logically grouped under collapsible menus (Radix Accordion).
For the AI Business Assistant, ensure the chat interface distinguishes between user messages and AI insights clearly, with a floating 'Voice' and 'File Upload' action.
DO NOT use ALL-CAPS labels on cards unless it's a specific overline (text-xs tracking-[0.2em]).
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters for icons.
Ensure Shadcn components are fully integrated and customized with the new color and typography rules.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing ones.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...).
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...}).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, specific transitions.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in headers, overlays, or dropdowns. Always use solid or blurred backgrounds.
All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`).
